title: Spicy Jamaican Herring Curry
description: A flavorful and spicy Jamaican-style curry made with herring, onions, garlic, ginger, and a blend of curry spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onion, garlic, and ginger; cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add herring and cook for 2-3 minutes, until lightly browned.
Add spicy curry sauce and stir to coat.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes, or until herring is cooked through.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Let the curry rest for at least 10 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
